s: Shello lehapsiq battepilla ubo z' seipim: lo yapsiq bitpillato. Vaapillu melek yisrael shoel bishlomo — lo yeshibennu. Abal melek ummot haolam sheyyesh lachosh shemma yahargennu — yapsiq. Umikkol maqom, im epshar lo leqatztzer, dehaynu sheyyomar techillat kol beraka vesopah qodem sheyyaggia elayv — yeqatztzer, shello yitztarek lehapsiq. O im epshar lo lehattot min hadderek — yitteh, velo yapsiq bedibbur. Veken im haya mitpallel badderek ubaa behema o qaron kenegdo — yitteh min hadderek velo yapsiq bedibbur. Abal beinyan acher — en lo latzet mimmeqomo ad sheyyigmor tepillato, ella im ken hu betachanunim sheachar hattepilla, sheaz muttar lo laaqor mimmeqomo al yede keriot vehishtachavayot (o letzorek acher). Abal shello letzorek — lo yazuz mimmeqomo ad sheyyipsa g' pesiot laachorayv kederek shenniptarim min hammelek:

Vaapillu nachash karuk al aqebo — lo yapsiq bedibbur lomar leacher lehasir mealayv hannachash. Abal yakol lelek lemaqom acher kede sheyyippol hannachash meraglo, shello matzinu halika shenniqret hapsaqa beshum maqom beemtza asiyyat hammitzva, ella shebbattepilla hoil veomed lipne hammelek — en lazuz mimmeqomo shello letzorek ad leachar hattepilla sheyyippater millipne hammelek beg' pesiot laachorayv kemo shennitbaer, abal letzorek kazeh muttar apillu beemtza birkot y"ch. Bammeh debarim amurim? Benachash sherob happaam eno noshek, abal aqrab shehu muad laaqotz ulehamit — poseq apillu bedibbur, sheen leka dabar sheomed bipne piqquach nepesh. Vaapillu nachash im roeh shehu kaus kenegdo uba lehazziqo — poseq apillu bedibbur:

Im raa shor ba kenegdo — poseq, shemmarchiqin mishshor tam chamishshim amma umimmuad kimlo enayv. Veim shevarim shebbammaqom hahu muchzaqim sheenam mazziqin — eno poseq, ella im ken raa shor shehizziq kebar paam achat:

Bekol maqom shepposeq, im shaha behapsaqato mechamat onso kede ligmor et kol hattepilla meroshah lesopah — chozer larosh kemo shennitbaer besiman s"h, umeshaarin lepi hammitpallel kemo shennitbaer sham. Veim lo shaha kol kak — chozer litchillat habberaka sheppasaq bah, im pasaq bedibbur beemtza ezo beraka mi"g berakot emtzaiyyot. Abal im pasaq beg' rishonot — chozer larosh, mippene shehen chashubot kibraka achat. Veim beg' acharonot — chozer li"retzeh", shehen chashubot gam ken keachat, sheg' rishonot hen keebed shemmesadder shebach lipne rabbo veg' acharonot hen keebed sheqqibbel peras merabbo venotel reshut veholek lo. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheppasaq bedibbur mechamat ones o beshogeg, abal im sach bemezid — chozer larosh bekol inyan (veakshav sherob haolam en nizharin lehasiach bebirkot qeriat shema — chashubim shogegim, sheomer muttar shogeg hu). Vaapillu im hipsiq bedibbur mechamat ones o beshogeg beemtza ezo beraka (mehaemtzaiyyot) velo chazar litchillat habberaka ella lammaqom sheppasaq vegamar tepillato veaqar raglayv — tzarik lachazor lerosh hattepilla, lepi sheotah beraka shehipsiq bedibbur beemtzaah enah ola lo ukeillu lo amarah kelal, vey"ch berakot meakkebot zo et zo, leinyan sheim dilleg achat mehen velo nizkar ad sheaqar raglayv — tzarik lachazor larosh kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qy"t (abal mi sheeno yodea lehitpallel kullan ella miqtzatan — yomar otan sheyyodea, veenan meakkebot zo et zo kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqtz"g[)]. Abal im hipsiq ben beraka libraka — gomer tepillato al hasseder apillu lekattechilla, vaapillu sach bemezid (chutz mig' rishonot veg' acharonot, shehen chashubot keachat lekol dabar). (Veyesh omerim sheapillu sach bemezid beemtza beraka yesh lo taqqana lachazor litchillat otah beraka miyyad achar hassicha, ella sheim achar hassicha chazar lammaqom sheppasaq vegamar tepillato), (o apillu otah beraka shessach bah lebaddah), ap al pi sheadayin lo aqar raglayv, sheim haya shogeg haya chozer litchillat habberaka shessach bah, akshav shehu mezid — tzarik lachazor larosh. Veken haddin im hezid velo hizkir geburot geshamim bitchiyyat hammetim o sheela be"birkat hashshanim" o shel rosh chodesh vechullo shel moed baaboda:

Apillu laanot qaddish ubareku uqedushsha — lo yapsiq bitpillat y"ch, ella yishtoq vikavven lemah sheomer hashsheliach tzibbur veyihyeh keoneh bepiv, sheshshomea keoneh bekol maqom, veap al pi ken en bazeh mishshum hepseq tepilla, kevan sheeno motzi bepiv. Ukeshemmaggia hashsheliach tzibbur baqqaddish le"yitbarek veyishtabbach" — chozer hu litpillato:
Haya omed bitpilla uqerauhu leseper tora — eno poseq, apillu lehaomerim shebbiqriat shema poseq veoleh leseper tora kemo shennitbaer besiman s"v:
Achar shessiyyem shemoneh esreh berakot qodem "elohay netzor" — yakol laanot qedushsha veqaddish ubareku kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qk"b:
